statements.text: A festival linked only to Moon phases can fall on different Gregorian dates in different years.
A festival tied to the solar year falls on nearly the same Gregorian date each year.
A luni-solar calendar never adds an intercalary month, so its festivals ignore the solar year.

stem:
Mehak compares three festival-date systems. One festival is linked only to Moon phases. Another is tied to the solar year. A third uses a luni-solar calendar that can add an intercalary month.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Purely lunar festivals shift on the Gregorian calendar; solar festivals stay near the same date. Luni-solar calendars do add intercalary months to limit the shift, so statement 3 is false.
